title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32 Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
